provenance.report: plan step 5: WinBox 4 running the Bridge workflow through the decrypting proxy (work/2026-11-jg-descriptors/winbox4/), 2026-11-22
provenance.capture_method: proxy.ts: WinBox logs in to the proxy (server-side EC-SRP5, srp-server.ts), the proxy logs in to the router and relays each M2 message decrypted; UI marks are the operator's confirmations after each step (not the exact click time)
provenance.session: W = the one WinBox connection; replies address TO=[0,n] where n is the WinBox handler that asked
provenance.lab_rows: ports *0 (m2ir-vl1, comment m2ir-p1) and *1 (m2ir-vl2, comment m2ir-p2) on bridge m2ir-br; comments changed over REST to m2ir-p1-c1 (window open) and m2ir-p1-c2 (window closed)
provenance.control: centrs over rest-api (drive.ts): setup, the two comment changes, print, cleanup

timeline.mark: note: previous comment failed (space in value), nothing written; retry
instruct-2: check comment, close Bridge window
ui-2: comment c1 shown; Bridge window closed (operator confirmed)
after comment c2 (+5 s), window closed
instruct-3: reopen Bridge > Ports, then move vl2 before vl1
ui-3: reopened (c2 shown), dragged vl2 above vl1, vl2 first (operator confirmed)
instruct-4: close, reopen Ports, check order, close, disconnect
ui-4: reopened with vl2 first, closed, disconnected (operator confirmed)

provenance.note: Sanitized M2 hex plus decoded entries: no hosts, ports, credentials or capture wall-clock time (tMs is ms since the WinBox login; the timeline uses the same origin). Router clock values inside [24,*] replies are the lab CHR's own. The plaintext starts after the SRP login. history_winbox: aff0013 (client address) redacted, u7 (time) zeroed, source address -> @<lab>.
